pages.text: Mila visits a food fair where each table shares a family meal.
She learns that rice is a common food in many countries.
Another table shows breads made from wheat or corn.
Colorful fruits and vegetables fill bowls with bright shapes.
Cooks add herbs and spices to make each dish smell and taste special.
At one meal, people use chopsticks. At another, they use spoons and forks.
Some families eat with clean hands in careful, respectful ways.
Mila takes one small bite of a new food and discovers she likes it.
She thanks the cooks and remembers farmers help grow the ingredients.
At home, she tells her family: food is learning, sharing, and care.
